verdict.rationale: Dover is a SaaS recruiting/ATS platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for it. None of the evidence items mention telemetry, analytics tracking, or any opt-out control; they cover only ATS, sourcing, API, and pricing features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
